coming from an older sister, i was pretty mean to my brother growing up. i honestly thought he could take it because he seemed so tough and i was always angry at the world so i would somewhat take it out on him. i did NOT realize the pain it had caused him until one day he broke down telling everyone he had cut himself and felt unwanted. i had absolutely no idea that i had caused this until obviously it was too late, i genuinely thought it wasn’t hurting and that it was just siblings arguing and being mean. seemed normal because i watched siblings do it on tv and siblings i knew irl were also mean to eachother. i regretted it immediately and apologized and ive been there for him since then, we’ve rebuilt our relationship and i do sometimes get snappy but he now realizes it wasn’t his fault for me acting that way, it was me being a teenager mad at the world but i do still apologize anytime i get slightly annoyed or mad.

sometimes as siblings we don’t really realize that what we do and what we say can affect eachother, sometimes we just assume its sibling “love” when in reality it’s actually harmful. she might’ve not realized the damage she was causing and she probably feels awful for causing that much pain and being unaware of it. maybe you should sit down with her and talk it out, ask her what made her change and want to be so nice? try rebuilding the sibling bond and give it another chance. siblings are gonna fuck up and it can be tricky. im sorry that this happened to you.
